cpmplus.extra.err.noLength: The animation has zero length. Set its length first.
cpmplus.extra.f5.menu: Close the loop (no jump at the end)
cpmplus.extra.f5.done: Loop closed: %s channel(s) now end where they start. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.extra.f5.nothing: The loop is already closed: nothing to change.
cpmplus.extra.f5.notLoop: This animation is not set to Loop. Its end now matches its start, but it only repeats in Loop mode.
cpmplus.extra.f6.title: Delay / advance motion
cpmplus.extra.f6.introAll: No part selected: the motion of ALL parts of this animation is shifted in time, wrapping around the end (the loop stays closed).
cpmplus.extra.f6.introSel: The motion of the %s selected part(s) is shifted in time, wrapping around the end. Great for offsetting wings, tails and hair.
cpmplus.extra.f6.amount.desc: Positive = later. Negative = earlier. Rounded to the animation's frame grid.
cpmplus.extra.f6.zero: The shift became zero after rounding to the frame grid. Use a larger value.
cpmplus.extra.f6.done: Motion shifted by %s s. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.extra.f6.nothing: The chosen parts have no keyframes in this animation.
cpmplus.extra.g63.title: Smooth motion
cpmplus.extra.g63.intro: Select 2 or more keyframes of the same channel in the timeline. Between each pair the chosen curve becomes keyframes on the frame grid, so it looks the same in game.
cpmplus.extra.g63.noKeys: Select at least 2 keyframes of the same channel (rotation, position, scale or colour) in the timeline.
cpmplus.extra.g63.tooClose: %s keyframe pair(s) are too close (under 2 frames) and were skipped. Raise the Animation quality (fps) to get frames in between.
cpmplus.extra.g63.done: Curve applied to %s segment(s). Ctrl+Z undoes it.
cpmplus.extra.g63.nothing: Nothing to change in the selected keyframes.
cpmplus.extra.f4.title: Generate blink
cpmplus.extra.f4.intro: Creates blinks on the %s selected part(s) (the eyes), spread evenly over the selected animation. Tip: use a Global animation set to Loop.
cpmplus.extra.f4.hide: Hide the eye for a moment
cpmplus.extra.f4.noParts: Select the eye parts (in the Outliner) before generating the blink.
cpmplus.extra.f4.tooShort: The animation is shorter than the blink. Make the animation longer.
cpmplus.extra.f4.notLoop: This animation is not set to Loop: it blinks only once per play.
cpmplus.extra.e2.title: CPM command cheat sheet
cpmplus.extra.e2.intro: Ready commands for each gesture and layer. /cpmclient animates only you. /cpm animate and /cpm detect are server commands (OP needed) and only listed for animations marked "Command controlled". Replace @p with a player name if you like.
cpmplus.extra.e2.none: This model has no gestures or layers to use in commands.
cpmplus.extra.g61.space: "%s" has a space or symbol: the command needs the name in quotes (already done in the list).
cpmplus.extra.g61.quote: "%s" has quotes in its name: the game command may reject it. Rename the animation without quotes.
cpmplus.extra.g3.title: Clean ghost colours
cpmplus.extra.g3.intro: Found %s colour channel(s) on parts that show no colour in game (no recolor and not a colour cube). Those keys do nothing in game and only clutter the timeline, so they can be removed without changing the model in game.
cpmplus.extra.g3.black: Also remove ALL-black colour channels on parts that do show colour
cpmplus.extra.g3.black.desc: Usually black saved by accident. Only tick this if you did not paint those parts black on purpose.
cpmplus.extra.g3.done: %s colour channel(s) cleaned. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
